description: This source file defines the abstract base class 'ValueDescriptor', which serves as a fundamental component within the 'MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Internals' namespace. It provides mechanisms for creating, getting, setting, and managing null states of various property types associated with document objects. The class is integral to the internal property descriptor infrastructure of the MigraDoc PDF creation library.

classes.name: ValueDescriptor
classes.description: An abstract base class providing a standardized interface for describing property values within document objects, including creation, retrieval, assignment, and null state management.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the value type described by this descriptor using reflection.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the value from a document object, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Abstract method to assign a value to a document object.

methods.name: SetNull
methods.description: Abstract method to set the associated property of a document object to null.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the property value of a document object is null.

methods.name: CreateValueDescriptor
methods.description: Internal static method that creates a specific subclass of ValueDescriptor based on property info and custom attributes.

methods.name: EnsureGetValueFlags
methods.description: Validates that the provided flags are defined in the GV enum type.

methods.name: EnsureCanWrite
methods.description: Checks if the value can be written, throwing an exception if it is read-only or the property cannot be written.
